quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #24
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 30

questions.question: When can you park or stop on a freeway shoulder?

options.text: If you turn on your emergency flashers.
If no part of your vehicle is on the road.
If you need to check a map for directions.
Only in an emergency.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only in an emergency.
questions.explanation: You cannot park on a freeway shoulder except during an emergency.

questions.question: Why should drivers be extra alert to motorcyclists, bicyclists, and pedestrians?

options.text: They are hard to see in traffic.
They follow different traffic laws than cars.
They always have the right-of-way.
They don't have rearview mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are hard to see in traffic.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles, bicycles, and pedestrians are smaller and harder to spot than cars. They move faster and have less noticeable lights. Drivers must always watch for them to prevent collisions.

questions.question: At a stop sign, what should you do?

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for cars behind you.
Move when the car ahead moves.
Look right, then left, then right again.
Look left, then right, then left again.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look left, then right, then left again.
questions.explanation: Look left first because vehicles from the left are closer to you. Then look right, then look left again to catch any vehicles you may have missed.

questions.question: This shape and color sign is a ____ sign.

options.text: No passing zone
Wrong way
Railroad crossing
Stop

questions.correctAnswerText: No passing zone
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to warn of a no passing zone.

questions.question: When a car ahead has blinding headlights, what should you do?

options.text: Use your bright lights until they dim theirs.
Flash your lights to warn the other driver.
Dim your lights and speed up to pass.
Look toward the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: Look away from the bright headlights and toward the right side of the road until the car passes. This keeps you from being blinded.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Steep downgrade ahead.
Crossroad ahead.
No right turn.
Narrow bridge.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep downgrade ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to road conditions. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or accidents.

questions.question: You turn left from a two-way street onto a one-way street. Where should your car be after the turn?

options.text: In the right lane.
In the center of the street.
In the left lane.
In the lane with the least traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the left lane.
questions.explanation: When turning left from a two-way street onto a one-way street, complete the turn into the lane closest to the lane you just left.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Curve ahead.
Roadwork ahead.
Merging traffic.
No left turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to road conditions. This sign warns that a curve is coming.

questions.question: You are waiting in the intersection to turn left. What should you do?

options.text: Signal and turn your wheels left.
Signal and keep your wheels straight.
Flash your headlights so cars will let you through.
Drive around a car that blocks you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal and keep your wheels straight.
questions.explanation: Always signal before turning. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn. If hit from behind, this prevents you from being pushed into oncoming traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Winding road.
No parking.
Right lane closed.
Multiple turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: Winding road.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to road conditions. This sign warns that a winding road is ahead. Slow down accordingly.

questions.question: Is it illegal for a car to share a lane with a motorcycle?

options.text: TRUE
FALSE

questions.correctAnswerText: TRUE
questions.explanation: Motorcyclists have the right to use a full traffic lane. Two motorcycles can share a lane, but cars cannot share a lane with a motorcycle.

questions.question: Children under age ____ must sit in an approved child safety seat.

options.text: Five
Six
Seven
Eight

questions.correctAnswerText: Eight
questions.explanation: All children under eight years old must be secured in a child safety seat or booster seat in vehicles made after January 1, 1968.

questions.question: To pass a slower vehicle on a two-lane, two-way road, you must:

options.text: Not cross the centerline.
Flash your lights at oncoming cars.
Use the shoulder.
Use the lane meant for oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the lane meant for oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Passing on a two-lane, two-way road requires you to use the oncoming traffic lane to complete your pass. Only pass if it is safe and legal to do so.

questions.question: What is true about bicycles?

options.text: They must stay on sidewalks.
They are vehicles but do not have the same rights as motor vehicles.
They are vehicles with the same rights as motor vehicles.
They must stay on bicycle paths.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are vehicles with the same rights as motor vehicles.
questions.explanation: Bicycles are vehicles with the same rights as motor vehicles. Bicyclists must follow the same traffic rules as other drivers. Bicyclists can ride on all public roads except interstate highways and freeways.

questions.question: When a vehicle with Anti-Lock Brakes starts to slip on a wet road, the driver should:

options.text: Pump the brakes.
Press and hold the brake pedal.
Press and hold the gas pedal.
Lightly tap the brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Press and hold the brake pedal.
questions.explanation: If your car loses grip on a slippery road, press hard on the brake pedal and hold it while steering to safety. Anti-Lock Brakes pump automatically faster than you can. Letting up on the brake or pumping it will turn off the Anti-Lock Brakes.

questions.question: When approaching an uncontrolled intersection, you should:

options.text: Keep your speed and go through.
Stop, look both ways, and then go.
Let all other drivers go first.
Be ready to yield if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to yield if needed.
questions.explanation: At an intersection with no stop sign or traffic light, yield to vehicles coming from the right. Always be ready to yield to prevent a crash. Take your foot off the gas, cover the brake, and look left, right, and left again.

questions.question: When passing a vehicle that just parked on the roadside, you should:

options.text: Expect the driver to open the door as you pass.
Speed up.
Brake hard.
Assume the driver will wait for you to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Expect the driver to open the door as you pass.
questions.explanation: When passing a parked car, be ready for the driver to open the door. Use extra care when driving near parked vehicles.

questions.question: If your vehicle starts to skid, you should:

options.text: Turn the wheel too far the other way.
Turn your wheel toward oncoming traffic.
Turn your wheel in the direction of the skid.
Let go of the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheel in the direction of the skid.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids, stay calm and steer in the direction the back of the car is sliding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends.
No right turn.
Road is slippery when wet.
Two-way traffic ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to road hazards and are usually yellow and black. This sign warns that a lane is ending and you should prepare to merge safely.

questions.question: When parking uphill next to a curb, set the parking brake and:

options.text: Keep the rear tires against the curb.
Keep the front tires straight.
Turn your wheel away from the curb.
Turn your wheel toward the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheel away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, set the parking brake and turn your wheel away from the curb. If your car rolls, it will roll into the curb and stop.

questions.question: When changing lanes to the left, look over which shoulder to check your blind spot?

options.text: Your right shoulder.
Your side mirror.
Your left shoulder.
Your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your left shoulder.
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move to check your blind spot.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: School crossing.
Pedestrian crossing.
Jogging trail.
Busy sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrian crossing.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that people may be crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: Which of these are used on some highways to show drivers which lanes to use for turning?

options.text: Flashing red lights
Flashing yellow lights
White lines on the side of the road
White arrows in the middle of the lanes

questions.correctAnswerText: White arrows in the middle of the lanes
questions.explanation: White arrows on the road show which lanes are for going straight or turning.

questions.question: If your car starts to skid, which way should you turn the steering wheel?

options.text: Keep the front wheels straight.
In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
In the opposite direction of the skid.
In any direction. It doesn't matter.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
questions.explanation: Turn the wheel in the direction you want to go. Once the car straightens out, turn the wheel back the other way.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Roundabout ahead.
No passing zone.
Left turn yield on green.
Traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: You come to an intersection with a flashing red light. What must you do?

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Turn right or left because the road ahead is blocked.
Stop and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop, then proceed when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then proceed when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop completely. Then go when the road is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road narrows ahead.
There are curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there are multiple curves in the road ahead.

questions.question: When you see a flashing yellow arrow at a traffic signal, what should you do?

options.text: Merge into the lane in the direction of the arrow.
Come to a complete stop.
You may turn left after letting oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass.
You have the right-of-way and oncoming traffic must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn left after letting oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow arrow allows left turns, but you must yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians first.

questions.question: You hear a siren but cannot see the emergency vehicle. What should you do?

options.text: Keep driving until you see the vehicle.
Pull to the curb and check if it is on your street.
Slow down but don't stop until you see it.
Speed up and turn at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the curb and check if it is on your street.
questions.explanation: If you hear a siren but don't know where it is, safely pull to the right side and stop until you know the vehicle is not coming toward you.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and traffic.
Slow down without stopping completely.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and check for pedestrians and traffic. Wait until the intersection is clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks under 18,000 lbs. are allowed.
A hill is ahead.
A truck stop is ahead.
No trucks are allowed.

questions.correctAnswerText: A hill is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does a single broken yellow line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Lanes go in opposite directions. You cannot pass.
Lanes go in opposite directions. You can pass when it is safe.
Lanes go in the same direction. You cannot pass.
Lanes go in the same direction. You can pass when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lanes go in opposite directions. You can pass when it is safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken line means you can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: When must you pull over and let an emergency vehicle pass?

options.text: No matter which direction you are going.
Only if it is coming from behind you.
Only if it is coming toward you.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter which direction you are going.
questions.explanation: Pull over to the right edge of the road and stop for an emergency vehicle with flashing lights. Do this whether it is behind you or coming toward you.

questions.question: Blood alcohol content (BAC) depends on all of the following, except:

options.text: Your body weight.
How much alcohol you drink.
How much time passes between drinks.
How physically fit you are.

questions.correctAnswerText: How physically fit you are.
questions.explanation: BAC depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. Physical fitness does not affect BAC.

questions.question: When entering a highway from an entrance ramp, you should generally:

options.text: Speed up more than traffic to get ahead.
Enter slowly to avoid other vehicles.
Stop first, then slowly enter traffic.
Speed up to match traffic speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match traffic speed.
questions.explanation: Use the acceleration lane to speed up. Signal, check for an opening, and merge into traffic at the same speed as other vehicles.
